prompt: PHASE 2: Independently inspect the continuous video to verify EVERY proposed event ID. Proposals are fallible hypotheses, not evidence. Follow ball and team possession in order. Never replace a proposal with an unrelated event; keep its ID, adjust time by at most 2 seconds. Reject only on visible contradiction.
